text: This is a really good app! I've tried a similar app, but it gave me too much freedom (I was too ambitious and kept adding premade goals to my stack). Fabulous keeps that ambition under control by restricting how many goals you can take on at a time, while also encouraging you to take baby steps and cheering you on along the way! Everything about Fabulous pushes you to become, well, more FABULOUS haha- but without being too lax or too pushy. They've struck a perfect balance and I love it ❤️
